records.g0_rationale: §2.3 `excluded_anhydrous`: the captured INCI contains no Aqua at all. ISODODECANE (a volatile hydrocarbon carrier) leads at r1, followed by DIMETHICONE r2 and DIMETHICONOL r3, then COCOS NUCIFERA OIL r4 and further botanical oils — an anhydrous silicone/oil serum, which §2.2 routes to the oil/serum category (SR §A.1). Classified by architecture, not by the word „Öl" in the name (§2.3). The rinse test (§2.4 rule 2) was run first, as required, and did not exclude: direction block 4 („Ein paar Tropfen … 10 Minuten vor der Haarwäsche verwenden") is a pre-wash contact-time-then-wash instruction, but nine of the ten captured direction blocks describe leave-on use, so clause 2 of the T17 H3 scoping applies — a dual-use direction that offers leave-on use as an alternative to rinsing keeps the record in-category at that test, with a `dual_use_directions` note and a review route. The exclusion therefore rests on architecture alone.

records.g0_rationale: §2.3.2 ordered rule 1 — both halves of the styling-first test are established at C1/C2 and no C1/C2 evidence points the other way. ARCHITECTURE HALF: the HOLD anchor (§7.7) returns `meaningful_hold_route`. VP/VA COPOLYMER, an enumerated fixative-class L5 polymer, sits at r3 of 15 in a hydroalcoholic film-forming context (AQUA r1, ALCOHOL DENAT. r2) and OUTRANKS the record's only conditioning species, POLYQUATERNIUM-11 at r4.
